description: Quantifies the q0 anchor mixing in the mu3 Frechet probe. Recomputes Delta^2 g three ways -- mixed (as merged), pure proton, pure muon -- on identical braid words. Door CLOSED under all three; the #4662 sign rule is anchor-independent (all 30 signs agree). Correct convention is pure muon per the AGENTS.md q0-anchor section.
caveats: DEFECT RECORDED, and it is a CALIBRATION-LAYER crossing, not a cache-staleness bug: mu3_frechet_perblock_probe.py (#4657, merged) took y_lambda from the IDEAL 3-CAL layer (muon-pinned, CAL-2 via proxy m_mu/m_e) while evaluating chi at the EXPERIMENTAL layer (proton-pinned q_parameter.Q). The 11.54 ppb separation is the mu-p substrate tension itself. Mechanism: y_lambda_at()'s fast path serves the ideal-layer cache to an experimental-layer caller with no layer-boundary signal. Correct fix is to pick a layer and stay in it -- for a categorical Delta^2 g in computations/, that layer is MUON. Size ~1e-7 relative; no conclusion changes. Recurring class flagged as bean tnjb.
q0AnchorReason: The subject of this probe IS the two-pin straddle: y_lambda and chi are evaluated at BOTH the experimental (proton) and ideal-CAL-2 (muon) pins and their separation is published as parameters.separation_ppb. Proton from q_parameter.Q_MP, muon from witness._q0_value_for_anchor('muon'), so both legs follow the anchor and neither can go stale.
